dye: Dye is a liquid with color that when placed on a fabric or other material, will change the color of it.

If you dye a fabric, you color it with dye.
dyed: If a fabric is dyed, it is colored with dye.
dyslexia: Dyslexia is a learning problem that makes it difficult to read. This may cause difficulties in writing also.
He is not able to do well in school because he has dyslexia.
dysprosium: Dysprosium is a metallic (meaning made of metal) element with an atomic number of 66 and the symbol Dy.

dynasty: A dynasty is a family of rulers who rule over a country for a long period of time.
North Korea is ruled by the Kim dynasty.
dyke: A dyke is a female homosexual.
dyspraxia: Dyspraxia is a disability in the brain that interferes with movement.
My dyspraxia makes my writing very messy.
dyscalculia: Dyscalculia is when a person has a mathematical disability.
dyslexic: A dyslexic is a person who has dyslexia.

dystopia: A dystopia is a dysfunctional society that has a very poor standard of living.
dystopian: If something is dystopian, it is related to a dystopia.
dysfunctional: If something is dysfunctional, it is not performing for its intended function.
dysfunction: A dysfunction is the failure to function in an expected or complete manner.
